_comment: Aggregates from analyse_block_A.py --check-overlap and plot_shape.py, which compute them from the stored Block A runs rather than re-solving. Regenerate with: python3 analyse_block_A.py --geometry disc|2part --check-overlap, and python3 plot_shape.py --geometry 2part. These figures are from the run with delta_R = 2 mm, per 5.5.2; an earlier run used 5 mm.

disc.numerical_floor: < 0.01 um in both L_pos and crown height, bounded by the 1e-8 m output precision

2part.numerical_floor: < 0.01 um in both L_pos and crown height, bounded by the 1e-8 m output precision
